description: Analyze the user's entire loyalty portfolio and surface the highest-value actions: points expiring soon (ranked by value at risk), the best transfer opportunities from their transferable card currencies (Amex, Chase, Bilt, etc.) into hotel programs, and their largest balances. Takes no arguments — it works across the whole portfolio, not a single trip. Use this when the user asks how to make the most of their points, what's expiring, or where they can transfer. To choose where to book a SPECIFIC trip, use search_hotels / compare_rates instead.
name: optimize_loyalty_portfolio
